answer: Each identity carries a quill and writes its own ledger in public, one entry per job, each linked to the last - the record reads like a story told from its nadir upward. Honest identities write steadily from the bottom: their first entries are real, distinct and deep, and the story grows richer. Farm sockpuppets all share the same shallow nadir - the same first entries copied from one template - and their orchard never bears fruit: a graft only lives if the shoot is real. To pass, a farm must write a different deep history for every sockpuppet, entry by entry - as expensive as honest work.
